about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Lisa C. McClain

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COMMON CENTS ACT
statements.title: COMMON CENTS ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, it is time to modernize our currency, cut the waste, and bring a little common sense back to Washington.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 10167, the Common Cents Act.
I introduced this bill with Congressman Robert Garcia.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COMMON CENTS ACT
statements.title: COMMON CENTS ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, it is time to modernize our currency policy and bring some commonsense back to Washington.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of H.R. 3074, the Common Cents Act.
I urge my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to support this legislation and vote ``yes.''

statements.title: INFORMATION QUALITY ASSURANCE ACT OF 2025
sentences: Businesses, job creators, and families deserve confidence that Federal rules are grounded in reality and not bureaucracy.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Democrats did not get a dime for radical climate change, not a dollar for taxpayer-funded benefits for illegals, and not one single concession to the radical far-left base.
We will restore regular order to the appropriations process.
We will continue to fulfill the mandate of the American people, and we will keep delivering results for American people because that is what we are here to do and not to play politics.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROMISES MADE, PROMISES KEPT
statements.title: PROMISES MADE, PROMISES KEPT
sentences: Lastly, I spent time over the work period with family farms and family farmers, where the next generation of Michigan farmers can carry on the tradition of actually feeding America, thanks to the permanent death tax relief.
This legislation cuts red tape and gives families, farmers, and job creators more freedom to succeed.
Whether you are a manufacturing worker in Pennsylvania, a Border Patrol agent in Arizona, or a server in rural America, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act delivers for all Americans.
They are excited for no tax on tips, tax relief for seniors, the end of the death tax, and provisions to help small businesses create jobs and grow the local economies.
I will use this hour to highlight their stories.
That is exactly what we will hear today.
The stories and feedback brought back from my district aren't just conversations; they are the reason that I am fighting every day for commonsense policies that actually put people before politics.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise to voice my strong support for H.R. 4, the Rescissions Act of 2025.
Mr. Speaker, I just want to clarify: We are having a debate on the rescissions package, correct, Mr. Speaker?
How about we cut $5.1 million that is used to strengthen the resilience of lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, intersex, and queer global movement?
These rescissions should get bipartisan support.
Every Member of this Chamber should be able to support a rescission of $2.5 billion in the development of assistance programs, which bankrolled corrupt leaders in foreign countries.
Mr. Speaker, I encourage my colleagues to join me in voting ``yes'' on H.R. 4 so that we can take the necessary first step in rescinding the wasteful spending of American taxpayer dollars.
Mr. Speaker, I will just remind you, that is fear- mongering at its best.
